name: loci-lens
description: Loci Lens — Augmented Reality Memory Palace for Snap SPECS

scripts.preview: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p=req.url==='/'?'preview/index.html':req.url.replace(/^\//,''); if(!fs.existsSync(p)) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Not found'); } const ext=path.extname(p); const ct={'html':'text/html','js':'application/javascript','css':'text/css'}[ext.slice(1)]||'text/plain'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':ct}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); }); server.listen(8080,()=>console.log('Loci Lens SPECS Preview running at http://localhost:8080/'));"

author: Devpost Learn SPECS Hackathon Team
